description.value:
A shimmering shroud of dark side energy wraps around you and your equipment, granting you 5 temporary hit points for the duration. While you have these temporary hit points, any creature that strikes you with a melee attack suffers 5 psychic damage in return.

Cast with a slot of 2nd level or higher, both the temporary hit points and the retaliatory psychic damage increase by 5 per slot level.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Dark Side Powers, Level 1
